messages:
anna_pm: Quick one — AWS FS pilot is asking for an "unlimited" burst window for first 90 days + priority routing on Dedicated. They're pushing for this to be in the contract. Thoughts on feasible packaging?

mike_revenue: we can't do unlimited. propose: 90d trial with a defined burst credit pool (X tokens/day) + option to convert to a burst add-on post-trial. upsell motion documented.

divya_eng: technical constraints: Dedicated priority routing requires reserved slots on pools. We can support priority queues but it increases committed capacity. if we allocate N GPUs for priority, latency SLO improves but cost goes up ~25%.

chris_sales: customer is sensitive to up-front commit. they'd prefer a usage-based baseline + a 3mo "high-burst" promo. Can we map burst credits to RPS or token budget so it's clear in contract?

lisa_pd: suggested packaging draft: base tiers (Starter/Scale/Enterprise) with soft commit bands; add-ons: burst_credits, priority_routing, extended_retention. burst_credits = prepaid token bucket; overage after bucket billed at premium rate. Include explicit per-route caps for noisy tenants.

ram_ops: billing complexity warning — prepaid bucket + premium overage means more edge cases in invoices. need clear telemetry keys in the runtime to attribute consumption: `tenant.burst.used`, `tenant.base.tokens`.

mike_revenue: contract levers that help sales: - trial_burst: one-time 90d bucket - soft_cap: monthly threshold with automated throttles and alerts - hard_cap override only with legal signoff

anna_pm: launch gating criteria idea: 1) runtime metrics surfaced in Console (burst usage, per-route throttle events) 2) billing prototype that handles prepaid bucket and premium overage 3) defined default soft_cap values per tier + docs and customer-facing examples

lisa_pd: pricing model example we can test: Starter = 0-50k tokens/day baseline; Scale = 50k-1M tokens/day; Enterprise = negotiated. Burst addon: +500k tokens prepaid at 20% premium. Priority routing = +flat monthly fee per 100 reserved slots.

divya_eng: engineering ask: can we implement prefix-level accounting and `burst_mode` flag in 6 sprint points. Priority routing needs scheduler changes; estimate 8-10 points with a small infra risk.

chris_sales: i'll push back with customer: define "burst" in tokens and convert customer examples to token estimates. if they want ephemeral unlimited for 90d, offer a measured bucket + SLA for fair use.

ram_ops: operational safety: add an automatic fallback policy to prevent runaway invoices — e.g., when overage > 2x baseline, auto-throttle and notify; override via account owner.

pricing-bot: draft PR created: `docs/pricing/burst_and_priority_v1.md` (ready for review).

anna_pm: action items: @mike_revenue draft contract language for trial_burst + overage rates; @divya_eng scope implementation RFC; @lisa_pd finalize tier defaults and add-on SKUs; @chris_sales convert customer traffic examples into token budget and share by EOD Friday. we'll sync Thurs 10am to lock launch gating. :thumbsup:

chris_sales: noted, will deliver numbers.

mike_revenue: on it.

divya_eng: will start RFC tomorrow.

lisa_pd: will post SKU sheet to the thread once ready.
